scope: descriptive counts over the whole encounter as annotated with full context, decisions included; they are not predictors, which stop at the pitch's cut
label: pitch-held-out estimate

reviewed_with_open_issues.note: reviewed records read although something is still open: validation errors of the reviewed record, or a structural (wrong, missing, absent or present) review judgment on a decision that no correction could apply. Nothing is excluded automatically.

outcome_unknown.rule: a pitch's outcome is unknown when no investor offered and at least one investor has neither an offer nor an exit on record, or when a reviewer judged it unknown

self_consistency.label: model self-consistency under sampling; not validity
